verdict.rationale: The first-party docs state that full-disk encryption is mandatory, so it is on by default rather than something the user must configure. The installer flow is described as writing the ISO to a USB stick and answering five questions to get a finished desktop, which fits the 'no manual security setup' part of the story. Missing for 10: details on the encryption mechanism and the passphrase or recovery setup during install, confirmation that encryption also applies to the dual-boot single-partition install, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
